shots.title: Open → enter the workspace
shots.action: The CSV selection gains a teal outline. Its row compresses briefly, then expands into the editor.
shots.camera: A 400ms push from selected file to workspace; settle immediately.
shots.transition: The selected file morphs into its editor tab in 400ms.
shots.voiceover: Start with a table you already have.
shots.source: Actual CSV and extension entry point.

shots.action: Car name, horsepower, and weight labels attach to the exact fields in the Impala row, with short stems and fitted outlines.
shots.camera: A 400ms approach, then a stable inspection of the Impala row.
shots.transition: The active weight token anchors the next row reveal.
shots.source: Actual CSV line 8: Chevrolet Impala, horsepower 220.0, weight 4354.0.

shots.title: Same number. Different row.
shots.action: The shared weight holds its screen lane while Impala and Civic row ribbons enter with crisp staggered movement.
shots.camera: A 400ms row match; ribbons settle without ongoing drift.
shots.transition: The Civic ribbon returns to CSV line 183 in 380ms.
shots.voiceover: An Impala and a Civic. Same weight, different context.
shots.source: Both weights and the car context are from the existing Auto MPG fixtures. These detached ribbons are editorial, not extension UI.

shots.title: Invoke TabLint
shots.action: The command palette appears in 350ms. Check this CSV receives a selection outline and a brief press pulse; the origin selection follows.
shots.camera: A 400ms return to a face-on desktop; menus appear without a slow camera move.
shots.transition: The command selection compresses and retracts as the label picker enters.
shots.source: extension.ts: check(), native VS Code palette and label picker.

> TabLint: Check this CSV with TabPFN-3.5

shots.title: A check becomes visible
shots.action: A time-compressed progress notification appears. The notification clears, then diagnostic underlines appear on their exact fields. No extra status badge is shown.
shots.camera: A 400ms approach to the warning, followed by a stationary view.
shots.transition: The active underline expands into the row-context overlay.
shots.source: Actual progress wording. No runtime or issue count will be invented.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help
TabLint: TabPFN-3.5 is reading the table…

shots.title: The whole row matters
shots.action: MPG, cylinders, and horsepower cards connect to the exact values in the Civic CSV row. Its weight stays outlined in the table.
shots.camera: Keep the native Civic row face-on; lock the camera while its context is explained.
shots.transition: The source values remain in place as the context cards retract in 380ms.
shots.voiceover: Every value is checked against its row.
shots.copy: A cell makes sense in context.
shots.source: Civic context: 33 mpg, 4 cylinders, 53 hp. Cinematic anatomy overlay is editorial.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help
The Civic row explains its weight.

shots.title: Read the diagnosis
shots.action: The weight field receives a focus outline. Its diagnostic opens in 350ms and the interval diagram resolves in 240ms.
shots.camera: Settle in 400ms, then lock while the diagnosis is read.
shots.transition: The interval collapses; the active-row band initiates a quick upward sweep.
shots.voiceover: For this Civic, the model expects about 1,877 pounds. Review the source.
shots.source: Frozen numeric report: expected 1877; 80% 1720–2034; surprise 3.24. The interval track is an editorial diagram.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help
TabLint: 4354.0 looks wrong for this row.
Implausible given the rest of the row.

shots.title: Follow the warning to the Rabbit
shots.action: An active-row band travels six lines upward in 400ms. The zero field is outlined and its diagnostic appears.
shots.camera: One fast 400ms row track with smooth deceleration; then a reading hold.
shots.transition: The diagnostic retracts into the Quick Fix selection.
shots.voiceover: Zero horsepower looks like a missing value. The suggestion is seventy.
shots.source: Rabbit line 177. Saved range 69.72–75.31 hp; answer key confirms original 70.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help
TabLint: 0.0 looks wrong for this row.

shots.title: Apply → correct → record
shots.action: Replace with 70 gains a teal selection outline with a clockwise perimeter highlight. The table’s horsepower changes from 0.0 to 70 in place, its highlight follows that field, and a receipt records the reason.
shots.camera: A quick 380ms adjustment after the press; no floating camera drift.
shots.transition: A 350ms receipt move leads into the categorical tab selection.
shots.voiceover: Apply the fix. Keep the reason.
shots.source: Exact Code Action labels. The receipt is an editorial representation of the persistent ledger event.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help

shots.title: Categorical columns, too
shots.action: The categorical CSV tab gains a selection outline. USA, Japan, and Europe labels sit beside their own rows, each connected by a short independent horizontal line.
shots.camera: Keep all three origin fields visible; labels remain level with their source values.
shots.transition: The category labels retract in 380ms; Toyota’s USA field anchors the diagnosis.
shots.source: Actual CSV lines 16, 20, and 21 show USA, Japan, and Europe. The Toyota suggestion remains provisional pending measured inference.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help

shots.title: Suggest a category. Flag for review.
shots.action: The origin field is outlined. The category suggestion appears, then Flag for review gains its own selection and clockwise perimeter highlight. A review note is entered.
shots.camera: A 400ms face-on approach; focus feedback identifies the chosen option.
shots.transition: The confirmed note becomes its file’s ledger note with a 350ms match.
shots.voiceover: Flag uncertain values for source review.
shots.source: Real Quick Fix and flag-note controls. Category suggestion shown is a storyboard placeholder, not a measured result.

TabLint: "USA" is unlikely in this row;
Why flag this value for review?

shots.title: Every decision has a reason
shots.action: Open decision ledger is selected and pulsed. Its panel enters in 400ms, retaining the categorical review reason and note.
shots.camera: A 400ms horizontal slide into the ledger, followed by a stable split view.
shots.transition: A 350ms tab-selection match switches to the numeric CSV and its own history.
shots.source: Ledger webview and append-only sidecar are implemented. Production uses a single CSV ledger per view; category and numeric records will be shown in their own file views.

typing.text: ●  Code   File   Edit   Selection   View   Go   Run   Terminal   Help
Why  Recorded category unlikely for row.

shots.title: Undo is an action, not an erasure
shots.action: A white callout points to the decision ledger: view all changes and their reasons, revert a fix, or flag for review. Undo restores zero and preserves history; reapply adds a new Applied record.
shots.camera: A 400ms two-plane adjustment; keep both value and ledger visible.
shots.transition: The corrected cell and two history records settle before the final pullback.
shots.voiceover: View every change and its reason. Revert a fix, or flag a value for review.
shots.source: Actual undo behavior preserves its event history and refuses to overwrite newer edits.
